notes.title: My Little Dictator released on D-Day!
notes.content:
[h1]My Little Dictator has just released on Steam on D-Day 2022![/h1]

A satirical dark-comedy parody of WW2, featuring genderbent anime dictators and generals! A ridiculous visual novel with turn-based battles, decision branches based on player choices, romance, drama and lots of fun things to play and unlock...

We hope you'll consider buying, playing, sharing and leaving a review for this wacky wartime comedy!

A huge thank you to all the backers, fans, supporters and creatives who worked with us over the years on getting this game completed. It wouldn't have happened without the combined efforts of everyone involved!

notes.title: My Little Dictator will launch on 6th June 2022, D-Day
notes.content:
[h1]My Little Dictator has an official launch date - 6th June 2022, D-Day![/h1]

That means there's only one week to go from now until you can finally play this satirical take on WW2 with cute, anime dictators and generals. Are you ready to storm the beaches of comedy and take on the gun nests of romance? Or something like that... [i]D-Day![/i]

[h3]Make sure to wishlist, follow, share and get the game when it finally lands here on Steam![/h3]

notes.title: Regarding videos/live streaming and derivative works of My Little Dictator
notes.content:

We hereby grant permission, to individuals and organizations, the right to post videos and live stream using footage from the game for commentary, analysis and/or other video content, regardless of commercial or non-commercial use. Please include the link below in the video description/summary when posting/livestreaming.

[u][b]Fan-art, illustrations, fan-made products, doujinshi[/b][/u]
We hereby grant permission to individuals the right to create and distribute derivative works on social media, video websites and at conventions/events etc., as long as the activities are within the scope of personal use/hobbies. However, we ask that you refrain from using official material/assets without making substantial modifications.
